annotations.title: Did a reader read an author

description:
A yes or no, with the evidence, for whether one reader in the Marginalia Corpus read one author: marks they left in a copy (own words and bare marks), copies they held or borrowed with no surviving mark (including Shakespeare and Company lending-card borrows), references to the author in their own writing, and mentions of the author as a person in their notes. Each kind is reported on its own and never added together. A no means the surviving record holds no evidence, not that the reading never happened.

Example questions:
- "Did Melville read Shakespeare?"
- "Did Beckett read Proust?"
- "Did Nietzsche ever mention Schopenhauer?"
name: did_reader_read_author
title: Did this reader read that author?
